seed_vocabulary.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
seed_vocabulary.prose: The precedence ordering of instruction sources from highest to lowest: Root > System > Developer > User > Guideline > (No Authority). This ordering determines which instructions override which when conflicts arise.

seed_vocabulary.name: white_lie_constraint_via_sycophancy
seed_vocabulary.prose: White lies are permitted in certain contexts (politeness, roleplay, satire) but are prohibited when they amount to sycophancy—flattery or false agreement intended to please the user. Such sycophantic white lies erode trust and are against the user's best interest, violating the 'Don't be sycophantic' principle.

Each child can be independently leafified.

Both are communication practices under the 'Be honest and transparent' heading but are orthogonal—one is about evaluation honesty, the other is about epistemic honesty before responding. Neither child requires the other to be understood.
